literal: for attaining / rare thing / if it occurs / at that very moment / for doing / difficult / actions (do)
translation: When a rare opportunity presents itself, use that very moment to accomplish tasks that are otherwise impossible to do.
modern: கிடைப்பதற்கு அரிய வாய்ப்பு கிடைத்தால், அந்த வாய்ப்பு இருக்கும்போதே செய்து முடிப்பதற்கு அரிய செயல்களைச் செய்து முடிக்க வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet emphasizes the importance of seizing the right moment. Opportunities that are hard to come by do not last long. Therefore, when such a rare chance occurs, one must act instantly to complete difficult tasks that cannot be done at any other time. The repetition of the word 'ariya' (rare or difficult) highlights both the scarcity of the opportunity and the greatness of the deed.
